info.title: ComfyUI Meta Viewer API
info.description: Public REST API contract for ComfyUI Meta Viewer (CMV), a local-first workspace for browsing generated media, inspecting embedded metadata and workflows, managing a virtual library, configuring AI providers, controlling ComfyUI, and running Simple Mode generation. All supported non-legacy `/api/*` routes are represented here. The pre-Simple-Mode `/api/editor/*` workflow editor is intentionally treated as legacy/internal and is excluded from this public contract.
